title: A 57-Floor Skyscraper Built in 19 Days #shorts
description:
In 2015, Broad Group assembled Mini Sky City in Changsha from 2,736 factory-made modules, about three floors a day.

New China Short every day; full reality-show recap every Saturday. Subscribe to @mainlandunpacked.

Sources: Mingtiandi; Fox News; Construction Digital (2015). Build-speed figures are the company's. Construction footage is illustrative (Pixabay), not Mini Sky City itself.

scenes.text: This 57-story skyscraper went up in 19 days.
scenes.say: This fifty-seven story skyscraper went up in nineteen days.
headline: 57 FLOORS
19 DAYS
scenes.source: Illustrative footage, not Mini Sky City

scenes.text: In 2015, Broad Group assembled Mini Sky City in Changsha, about three floors a day.
The trick: almost nothing was built on site. 2,736 modules were made in a factory first.
scenes.label: made in a factory over about four and a half months

scenes.text: Then cranes stacked them like building blocks: 800 apartments, plus offices for about 4,000 people.
It was a warm-up for Sky City, a planned 838-meter tower that would have beaten the Burj Khalifa. It was never built.
Would you live in a tower built in 19 days?
scenes.say: Would you live in a tower built in nineteen days?
scenes.question: WOULD YOU LIVE HERE?
